1//! A cache containing data received from [`Shard`]s.
2//!
3//! Using the cache allows to avoid REST API requests via the [`http`] module where possible.
4//! Issuing too many requests will lead to ratelimits.
5//!
6//! # Use by Models
7//!
8//! Most models of Discord objects, such as the [`Message`], [`GuildChannel`], or [`Emoji`], have
9//! methods for interacting with that single instance. This feature is only compiled if the `model`
10//! feature is enabled. An example of this is [`Guild::edit`], which performs a check to ensure that
11//! the current user has the [Manage Guild] permission prior to actually performing the HTTP
12//! request. The cache is involved due to the function's use of unlocking the cache and retrieving
13//! the permissions of the current user. This is an inexpensive method of being able to access data
14//! required by these sugary methods.
15//!
16//! # Do I need the Cache?
17//!
18//! If you're asking this, the answer is likely "definitely yes" or "definitely no"; any in-between
19//! tends to be "yes". If you are low on RAM, and need to run on only a couple MB, then the answer
20//! is "definitely no". If you do not care about RAM and want your bot to be able to access data
21//! while needing to hit the REST API as little as possible, then the answer is "yes".
22//!
23//! [`Shard`]: crate::gateway::Shard
24//! [`http`]: crate::http
25//! [Manage Guild]: Permissions::MANAGE_GUILD
26

56struct NotSend;

58enum CacheRefInner<'a, K, V, T> {
59    #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
60    Arc(Arc<V>),
61    DashRef(Ref<'a, K, V>),
62    DashMappedRef(MappedRef<'a, K, T, V>),
63    ReadGuard(parking_lot::RwLockReadGuard<'a, V>),
64}
65
66pub struct CacheRef<'a, K, V, T = ()> {
67    inner: CacheRefInner<'a, K, V, T>,
68    phantom: std::marker::PhantomData<*const NotSend>,
69}
70
71impl<'a, K, V, T> CacheRef<'a, K, V, T> {
72    fn new(inner: CacheRefInner<'a, K, V, T>) -> Self {
73        Self {
74            inner,
75            phantom: std::marker::PhantomData,
76        }
77    }
78
79    #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
80    fn from_arc(inner: MaybeOwnedArc<V>) -> Self {
81        Self::new(CacheRefInner::Arc(inner.get_inner()))
82    }
83
84    fn from_ref(inner: Ref<'a, K, V>) -> Self {
85        Self::new(CacheRefInner::DashRef(inner))
86    }
87
88    fn from_mapped_ref(inner: MappedRef<'a, K, T, V>) -> Self {
89        Self::new(CacheRefInner::DashMappedRef(inner))
90    }
91
92    fn from_guard(inner: parking_lot::RwLockReadGuard<'a, V>) -> Self {
93        Self::new(CacheRefInner::ReadGuard(inner))
94    }
95}

97impl<K: Eq + Hash, V, T> std::ops::Deref for CacheRef<'_, K, V, T> {
98    type Target = V;
99
100    fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {
101        match &self.inner {
102            #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
103            CacheRefInner::Arc(inner) => inner,
104            CacheRefInner::DashRef(inner) => inner.value(),
105            CacheRefInner::DashMappedRef(inner) => inner.value(),
106            CacheRefInner::ReadGuard(inner) => inner,
107        }
108    }
109}

128/// A cache containing data received from [`Shard`]s.
129///
130/// Using the cache allows to avoid REST API requests via the [`http`] module where possible.
131/// Issuing too many requests will lead to ratelimits.
132///
133/// This is the list of cached resources and the events that populate them:
134/// - channels: [`ChannelCreateEvent`], [`ChannelUpdateEvent`], [`GuildCreateEvent`]
135/// - guilds: [`GuildCreateEvent`]
136/// - unavailable_guilds: [`ReadyEvent`], [`GuildDeleteEvent`]
137/// - users: [`GuildMemberAddEvent`], [`GuildMemberRemoveEvent`], [`GuildMembersChunkEvent`],
138///   [`PresenceUpdateEvent`], [`ReadyEvent`]
139/// - presences: [`PresenceUpdateEvent`], [`ReadyEvent`]
140/// - messages: [`MessageCreateEvent`]
141///
142/// The documentation of each event contains the required gateway intents.
143///
144/// [`Shard`]: crate::gateway::Shard
145/// [`http`]: crate::http
146#[cfg_attr(feature = "typesize", derive(typesize::derive::TypeSize))]
147#[derive(Debug)]
148#[non_exhaustive]
149pub struct Cache {
150    // Temp cache:
151    // ---
152    /// Cache of channels that have been fetched via to_channel.
153    ///
154    /// The TTL for each value is configured in CacheSettings.
155    #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
156    pub(crate) temp_channels: MokaCache<ChannelId, MaybeOwnedArc<GuildChannel>, BuildHasher>,
157    /// Cache of threads that have been fetched via to_channel.
158    ///
159    /// The TTL for each value is configured in CacheSettings.
160    #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
161    pub(crate) temp_threads: MokaCache<ThreadId, MaybeOwnedArc<GuildThread>, BuildHasher>,
162    /// Cache of private channels created via create_dm_channel.
163    ///
164    /// The TTL for each value is configured in CacheSettings.
165    #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
166    pub(crate) temp_private_channels: MokaCache<UserId, MaybeOwnedArc<PrivateChannel>, BuildHasher>,
167    /// Cache of messages that have been fetched via message.
168    ///
169    /// The TTL for each value is configured in CacheSettings.
170    #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
171    pub(crate) temp_messages: MokaCache<MessageId, MaybeOwnedArc<Message>, BuildHasher>,
172    /// Cache of users who have been fetched from `to_user`.
173    ///
174    /// The TTL for each value is configured in CacheSettings.
175    #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
176    pub(crate) temp_users: MokaCache<UserId, MaybeOwnedArc<User>, BuildHasher>,
177
178    // Guilds cache:
179    // ---
180    /// A map of guilds with full data available. This includes data like [`Role`]s and [`Emoji`]s
181    /// that are not available through the REST API.
182    guilds: MaybeMap<GuildId, Guild>,
183    /// A list of guilds which are "unavailable".
184    ///
185    /// Additionally, guilds are always unavailable for bot users when a Ready is received. Guilds
186    /// are "sent in" over time through the receiving of [`Event::GuildCreate`]s.
187    unavailable_guilds: MaybeMap<GuildId, ()>,
188
189    // Messages cache:
190    // ---
191    messages: DashMap<GenericChannelId, VecDeque<Message>, BuildHasher>,
192
193    // Miscellanous fixed-size data
194    // ---
195    /// Information about running shards
196    shard_data: RwLock<CachedShardData>,
197    /// The current user "logged in" and for which events are being received for.
198    ///
199    /// The current user contains information that a regular [`User`] does not, such as whether it
200    /// is a bot, whether the user is verified, etc.
201    ///
202    /// Refer to the documentation for [`CurrentUser`] for more information.
203    user: RwLock<CurrentUser>,
204    /// The settings for the cache.
205    settings: RwLock<Settings>,
206}

208impl Cache {
209    /// Creates a new cache.
210    #[must_use]
211    pub fn new() -> Self {
212        Self::default()
213    }

215    /// Creates a new cache instance with settings applied.
216    ///
217    /// # Examples
218    ///
219    /// ```rust
220    /// use serenity::cache::{Cache, Settings};
221    ///
222    /// let mut settings = Settings::default();
223    /// settings.max_messages = 10;
224    ///
225    /// let cache = Cache::new_with_settings(settings);
226    /// ```
227    #[cfg_attr(feature = "tracing_instrument", instrument)]
228    pub fn new_with_settings(settings: Settings) -> Self {
229        #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
230        fn temp_cache<K, V>(ttl: Duration) -> MokaCache<K, V, BuildHasher>
231        where
232            K: Hash + Eq + Send + Sync + 'static,
233            V: Clone + Send + Sync + 'static,
234        {
235            MokaCache::builder().time_to_live(ttl).build_with_hasher(BuildHasher::default())
236        }
237
238        Self {
239            #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
240            temp_private_channels: temp_cache(settings.time_to_live),
241            #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
242            temp_channels: temp_cache(settings.time_to_live),
243            #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
244            temp_threads: temp_cache(settings.time_to_live),
245            #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
246            temp_messages: temp_cache(settings.time_to_live),
247            #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
248            temp_users: temp_cache(settings.time_to_live),
249
250            guilds: MaybeMap(settings.cache_guilds.then(DashMap::default)),
251            unavailable_guilds: MaybeMap(settings.cache_guilds.then(DashMap::default)),
252
253            messages: DashMap::default(),
254
255            shard_data: RwLock::new(CachedShardData {
256                total: NonZeroU16::MIN,
257                connected: HashSet::new(),
258                has_sent_shards_ready: false,
259            }),
260            user: RwLock::new(CurrentUser::default()),
261            settings: RwLock::new(settings),
262        }
263    }
264
265    /// Fetches the number of [`Member`]s that have not had data received.
266    ///
267    /// The important detail to note here is that this is the number of _member_s that have not had
268    /// data received. A single [`User`] may have multiple associated member objects that have not
269    /// been received.
270    ///
271    /// This can be used in combination with [`Shard::chunk_guild`], and can be used to determine
272    /// how many members have not yet been received.
273    ///
274    /// [`Shard::chunk_guild`]: crate::gateway::Shard::chunk_guild
275    pub fn unknown_members(&self) -> u32 {
276        let mut total = 0;
277
278        for guild_entry in self.guilds.iter() {
279            let guild = guild_entry.value();
280
281            let known_member_count = guild.members.len() as u32;
282            let member_count_estimate = guild.member_count.get();
283            if member_count_estimate > known_member_count {
284                total += member_count_estimate - known_member_count;
285            }
286        }
287
288        total
289    }
290
291    /// Fetches a vector of all [`Guild`]s' Ids that are stored in the cache.
292    ///
293    /// Note that if you are utilizing multiple [`Shard`]s, then the guilds retrieved over all
294    /// shards are included in this count -- not just the current [`Context`]'s shard, if accessing
295    /// from one.
296    ///
297    /// # Examples
298    ///
299    /// Print all of the Ids of guilds in the Cache:
300    ///
301    /// ```rust,no_run
302    /// # use serenity::model::event::FullEvent;
303    /// # use serenity::prelude::*;
304    ///
305    /// struct Handler;
306    ///
307    /// #[serenity::async_trait]
308    /// impl EventHandler for Handler {
309    ///     async fn dispatch(&self, ctx: &Context, event: &FullEvent) {
310    ///         match event {
311    ///             FullEvent::Ready {
312    ///                 data_about_bot, ..
313    ///             } => {
314    ///                 let guilds = ctx.cache.guilds().len();
315    ///                 println!("Guilds in the Cache: {guilds}");
316    ///             },
317    ///             _ => {},
318    ///         }
319    ///     }
320    /// }
321    /// ```
322    ///
323    /// [`Context`]: crate::gateway::client::Context
324    /// [`Shard`]: crate::gateway::Shard
325    pub fn guilds(&self) -> Vec<GuildId> {
326        let unavailable_guilds = self.unavailable_guilds();
327
328        let unavailable_guild_ids = unavailable_guilds.iter().map(|i| *i.key());
329
330        self.guilds.iter().map(|i| *i.key()).chain(unavailable_guild_ids).collect()
331    }

333    /// Get a reference to the cached messages for a channel based on the given `Id`.

339    /// ```rust,no_run

341    /// #
342    /// # let cache: serenity::cache::Cache = todo!();
343    /// if let Some(messages_in_channel) = cache.channel_messages(GenericChannelId::new(7)) {
344    ///     let messages_by_user: Vec<_> =

346    /// }
347    /// ```

349        self.messages.get(&channel_id).map(CacheRef::from_ref)

387    /// Retrieves a [`Channel`]'s message from the cache based on the channel's and message's given
388    /// Ids.
389    ///
390    /// **Note**: This will clone the entire message.
391    ///
392    /// # Examples
393    ///
394    /// Retrieving the message object from a channel.
395    ///
396    /// ```rust,no_run
397    /// # use serenity::cache::Cache;
398    /// # use serenity::model::channel::Message;
399    /// #
400    /// # fn run(cache: Cache, message: Message) {
401    /// #
402    /// match cache.message(message.channel_id, message.id) {
403    ///     Some(m) => assert_eq!(message.content, m.content),
404    ///     None => println!("No message found in cache."),
405    /// };
406    /// # }
407    /// ```
408    pub fn message(
409        &self,
410        channel_id: GenericChannelId,
411        message_id: MessageId,
412    ) -> Option<MessageRef<'_>> {
413        #[cfg(feature = "temp_cache")]
414        if let Some(message) = self.temp_messages.get(&message_id) {
415            return Some(CacheRef::from_arc(message));
416        }
417
418        let messages = self.messages.get(&channel_id)?;
419        let message =
420            messages.try_map(|messages| messages.iter().find(|m| m.id == message_id)).ok()?;
421        Some(CacheRef::from_mapped_ref(message))
422    }

424    /// Returns the settings.
425    ///
426    /// # Examples
427    ///
428    /// Printing the maximum number of messages in a channel to be cached:
429    ///
430    /// ```rust
431    /// use serenity::cache::Cache;
432    ///
433    /// # fn test() {
434    /// let mut cache = Cache::new();
435    /// println!("Max settings: {}", cache.settings().max_messages);
436    /// # }
437    /// ```
438    pub fn settings(&self) -> SettingsRef<'_> {
439        CacheRef::from_guard(self.settings.read())
440    }
441
442    /// Sets the maximum amount of messages per channel to cache.
443    ///
444    /// By default, no messages will be cached.
445    pub fn set_max_messages(&self, max: usize) {
446        // Check to see if cache has to be truncated
447        if max < self.settings.read().max_messages {
448            for mut entry in self.messages.iter_mut() {
449                let message_queue = entry.value_mut();
450                let queue_len = message_queue.len();
451
452                if queue_len > max {
453                    message_queue.drain(..queue_len - max);
454                }
455            }
456        }
457
458        self.settings.write().max_messages = max;
459    }

461    /// This method provides a reference to the user used by the bot.

463        CacheRef::from_guard(self.user.read())

466    /// Clones all channel categories in the given guild and returns them.
467    pub fn guild_categories(
468        &self,
469        guild_id: GuildId,
470    ) -> Option<ExtractMap<ChannelId, GuildChannel>> {
471        let guild = self.guilds.get(&guild_id)?;
472
473        let filter = |channel: &&GuildChannel| channel.base.kind == ChannelType::Category;
474        Some(guild.channels.iter().filter(filter).cloned().collect())
475    }
476
477    /// Inserts new messages into the message cache for a channel manually.
478    ///
479    /// This will keep the ordering of the message cache consistent, even if the message iterator
480    /// contains randomly ordered messages, and respects the [`Settings::max_messages`] setting.
481    pub(crate) fn fill_message_cache(
482        &self,
483        channel_id: GenericChannelId,
484        new_messages: impl Iterator<Item = Message>,
485    ) {
486        let max_messages = self.settings().max_messages;
487        if max_messages == 0 {
488            // Early exit for common case of message cache being disabled.
489            return;
490        }
491
492        let mut channel_messages = self.messages.entry(channel_id).or_default();
493
494        // Fill up the existing cache
495        channel_messages.extend(new_messages.take(max_messages));
496        // Make sure the cache stays sorted to messages
497        channel_messages.make_contiguous().sort_unstable_by_key(|m| m.id);
498        // Get rid of the overflow at the front of the queue.
499        let truncate_end_index = channel_messages.len().saturating_sub(max_messages);
500        channel_messages.drain(..truncate_end_index);
501    }
502
503    /// Updates the cache with the update implementation for an event or other custom update
504    /// implementation.
505    ///
506    /// Refer to the documentation for [`CacheUpdate`] for more information.
507    ///
508    /// # Examples
509    ///
510    /// Refer to the [`CacheUpdate` examples].
511    ///
512    /// [`CacheUpdate` examples]: CacheUpdate#examples
513    #[cfg_attr(feature = "tracing_instrument", instrument(skip(self, e)))]
514    pub fn update<E: CacheUpdate>(&self, e: &mut E) -> Option<E::Output> {
515        e.update(self)
516    }
517}

525#[cfg(test)]
526mod test {
527    use std::str::FromStr;
528
529    use crate::cache::{Cache, CacheUpdate, Settings};
530    use crate::model::prelude::*;
531
532    #[test]
533    fn test_cache_messages() {
534        let settings = Settings {
535            max_messages: 2,
536            ..Default::default()
537        };
538        let cache = Cache::new_with_settings(settings);
539
540        // Test inserting one message into a channel's message cache.
541        let mut event = MessageCreateEvent {
542            message: Message {
543                id: MessageId::new(3),
544                guild_id: Some(GuildId::new(1)),
545                ..Default::default()
546            },
547        };
548
549        // Check that the channel cache doesn't exist.
550        assert!(!cache.messages.contains_key(&event.message.channel_id));
551        // Add first message, none because message ID 2 doesn't already exist.
552        assert!(event.update(&cache).is_none());
553        // None, it only returns the oldest message if the cache was already full.
554        assert!(event.update(&cache).is_none());
555        // Assert there's only 1 message in the channel's message cache.
556        assert_eq!(cache.messages.get(&event.message.channel_id).unwrap().len(), 1);
557
558        // Add a second message, assert that channel message cache length is 2.
559        event.message.id = MessageId::new(4);
560        assert!(event.update(&cache).is_none());
561        assert_eq!(cache.messages.get(&event.message.channel_id).unwrap().len(), 2);
562
563        // Add a third message, the first should now be removed.
564        event.message.id = MessageId::new(5);
565        assert!(event.update(&cache).is_some());
566
567        // Add a reaction for a channel
568        let message = &event.message;
569        let reaction_type = ReactionType::Unicode(FixedString::from_str("\u{2753}").unwrap());
570        let second_reaction_type =
571            ReactionType::Unicode(FixedString::from_str("\u{2757}").unwrap());
572
573        let mut reaction_event = ReactionAddEvent {
574            reaction: Reaction {
575                user_id: Some(UserId::new(1)),
576                channel_id: message.channel_id,
577                message_id: message.id,
578                guild_id: message.guild_id,
579                member: None,
580                emoji: reaction_type.clone(),
581                message_author_id: Some(message.author.id),
582                burst: false,
583                burst_colours: None,
584                reaction_type: ReactionTypes::Normal,
585            },
586        };
587
588        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_event).is_some());
589
590        {
591            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
592            let message =
593                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
594
595            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 1);
596        }
597
598        // Add second reaction
599        reaction_event.reaction.emoji = second_reaction_type;
600
601        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_event).is_some());
602
603        {
604            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
605            let message =
606                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
607
608            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 2);
609        }
610
611        // Add a burst reaction
612        reaction_event.reaction.emoji = reaction_type.clone();
613        reaction_event.reaction.burst = true;
614        reaction_event.reaction.reaction_type = ReactionTypes::Burst;
615
616        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_event).is_some());
617
618        {
619            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
620            let message =
621                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
622
623            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 2);
624            assert!(
625                message
626                    .reactions
627                    .iter()
628                    .find(|r| r.reaction_type == reaction_type
629                        && r.count == 2
630                        && r.count_details.burst == 1)
631                    .is_some()
632            );
633        }
634
635        // Remove a reaction
636        let mut reaction_remove_event = ReactionRemoveEvent {
637            reaction: reaction_event.reaction.clone(),
638        };
639
640        reaction_remove_event.reaction.emoji = reaction_type.clone();
641
642        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_remove_event).is_some());
643
644        {
645            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
646            let message =
647                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
648
649            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 2);
650            assert!(
651                message
652                    .reactions
653                    .iter()
654                    .find(|r| r.reaction_type == reaction_type
655                        && r.count == 1
656                        && r.count_details.burst == 0)
657                    .is_some()
658            );
659        }
660
661        // Remove normal reaction, so the entire reaction should be removed
662        reaction_remove_event.reaction.burst = false;
663        reaction_remove_event.reaction.reaction_type = ReactionTypes::Normal;
664
665        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_remove_event).is_some());
666
667        {
668            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
669            let message =
670                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
671
672            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 1);
673        }
674
675        // The instance should be removed when ReactionRemoveEmojiEvent is fired
676        let mut reaction_remove_event = ReactionRemoveEmojiEvent {
677            reaction: reaction_event.reaction.clone(),
678        };
679
680        // First prepare test data
681        reaction_event.reaction.emoji = reaction_type.clone();
682        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_event).is_some());
683
684        reaction_event.reaction.burst = false;
685        reaction_event.reaction.reaction_type = ReactionTypes::Normal;
686
687        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_event).is_some());
688
689        reaction_event.reaction.user_id = Some(UserId::new(2));
690        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_event).is_some());
691
692        {
693            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
694            let message =
695                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
696
697            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 2);
698            assert!(
699                message
700                    .reactions
701                    .iter()
702                    .find(|r| r.reaction_type == reaction_type
703                        && r.count == 3
704                        && r.count_details.burst == 1
705                        && r.count_details.normal == 2)
706                    .is_some()
707            );
708        }
709
710        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_remove_event).is_some());
711
712        {
713            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
714            let message =
715                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
716            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 1);
717        }
718
719        // All reactions should be removed when ReactionRemoveAllEvent is fired
720        let mut reaction_remove_event = ReactionRemoveAllEvent {
721            message_id: reaction_event.reaction.message_id,
722            channel_id: reaction_event.reaction.channel_id,
723            guild_id: reaction_event.reaction.guild_id,
724        };
725
726        // First add second reaction
727        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_event).is_some());
728
729        {
730            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
731            let message =
732                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
733            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 2);
734        }
735
736        // Remove all reactions
737        assert!(cache.update(&mut reaction_remove_event).is_some());
738
739        {
740            let channel = cache.messages.get(&reaction_event.reaction.channel_id).unwrap();
741            let message =
742                channel.iter().find(|m| m.id == reaction_event.reaction.message_id).unwrap();
743
744            assert_eq!(message.reactions.len(), 0);
745        }
746
747        {
748            let channel = cache.messages.get(&event.message.channel_id).unwrap();
749
750            assert_eq!(channel.len(), 2);
751            // Check that the first message is now removed.
752            assert!(!channel.iter().any(|m| m.id == MessageId::new(3)));
753        }
754
755        let channel = GuildChannel {
756            id: event.message.channel_id.expect_channel(),
757            base: BaseGuildChannel {
758                guild_id: event.message.guild_id.unwrap(),
759                ..Default::default()
760            },
761            ..Default::default()
762        };
763
764        // Add a channel delete event to the cache, the cached messages for that channel should now
765        // be gone.
766        let mut delete = ChannelDeleteEvent {
767            channel: channel.clone(),
768        };
769        assert!(cache.update(&mut delete).is_some());
770        assert!(!cache.messages.contains_key(&delete.channel.id.into()));
771
772        // Test deletion of a guild channel's message cache when a GuildDeleteEvent is received.
773        let mut guild_create = GuildCreateEvent {
774            guild: Guild {
775                id: GuildId::new(1),
776                channels: ExtractMap::from_iter([channel]),
777                ..Default::default()
778            },
779        };
780        assert!(cache.update(&mut guild_create).is_some());
781        assert!(cache.update(&mut event).is_none());
782
783        let mut guild_delete = GuildDeleteEvent {
784            guild: UnavailableGuild {
785                id: GuildId::new(1),
786                unavailable: false,
787            },
788        };
789
790        // The guild existed in the cache, so the cache's guild is returned by the update.
791        assert!(cache.update(&mut guild_delete).is_some());
792
793        // Assert that the channel's message cache no longer exists.
794        assert!(!cache.messages.contains_key(&GenericChannelId::new(2)));
795    }
796}
